crossRefs.note: He causes the clouds to rise from the ends of the earth. He makes lightnings with the rain. He brings the wind out of…
Who has measured the waters in the hollow of his hand, and marked off the sky with his span, and calculated the dust of…

translations.web: He establishes the force of the wind. Yes, he measures out the waters by measure.
translations.bsb: When God fixed the weight of the wind and measured out the waters,
translations.kjv: To make the weight for the winds; and he weigheth the waters by measure.
translations.asv: To make a weight for the wind: Yea, he meteth out the waters by measure.
